flag.sync.e2ee.desc: Sync your notes between devices through a storage service that sees only encrypted data. Experimental and off by default until an open item of its security review is fixed. Back up your notes folder before you try it.
flag.sync.e2ee.name: Encrypted sync (experimental)
flag.update.checkOnLaunch.desc: Desktop app: look for a new version once a day when Lumen starts, so beta fixes arrive quickly. Never in local-only mode; every check is in the privacy log.
flag.update.checkOnLaunch.name: Check for updates at launch
flags.intro.beta: This is a beta build: features still in beta are on. You can turn any of them off here; the choice stays on this device.
flags.intro.stable: Features still in beta are off in this build. You can try one here; the choice stays on this device.
flags.title: Feature flags
